parts.name: Switch
parts.Basic_description: The switch is a small lever or handle made of stainless steel, used to control water flow and temperature in the faucet.
parts.Functional_description: It allows the user to turn the water on or off and adjust the temperature by rotating or lifting the handle.
parts.Movement_description: It can rotate or tilt around a pivot axis to regulate water flow and temperature.

parts.name: Frame
parts.Basic_description: The frame is the main cylindrical body of the faucet made of stainless steel, housing the internal valves and connecting the spout and switch.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the faucet structure, connects to the water supply, and contains the internal mixing and control mechanisms.
parts.Movement_description: It remains fixed and does not move during normal operation.

parts.name: Spout
parts.Basic_description: The spout is the curved tubular part of the faucet made of stainless steel, through which water flows out.
parts.Functional_description: It directs the water from the faucet body to the sink, ensuring smooth and controlled flow.
parts.Movement_description: It may swivel horizontally in some designs to direct water flow to different areas of the sink.
